title: Application of Boston Edison Company, under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 94G, as amended by St. 1981, c. 375, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of the Company's annnual performance program relating of fuel precurement and use. The performance program must be filed by each electric company having a fuel charge approved by the Department. The Company's annual performance program purposes efficiency goals for each generating unit owned or operated by the Company and for each generating unit from which the Company receive power under a specific unit contract.
